In a love triangle, the two men may be watching each other the most

When two men compete for one woman, who is watching whom most intensely? Eve Kosofsky Sedgwick said the germ of『Between Men』came from noticing that male rivals often seemed more preoccupied with each other than with the woman they supposedly desired. This essay follows that odd observation into male homosocial desire: a broad field including friendship, mentorship, rivalry, hierarchy, homosexual relations, and economic exchange. 「ホモソーシャル＝男だけの嫌なノリ」でも、「実は同性愛」でもない。The concept becomes useful when it helps us trace whose recognition creates value, how women can mediate male relations, and how homophobia can police the boundary of acceptable male intimacy.
